title: UE-side suite claims to mirror spine_check but omits the r1-driven regression tests (contention, failed-replay latch, same-tick latch)
detail: Header comment overstates the mirror: the r1-warning regression checks (serve-pass contention, failed-replay-command latch, same-tick re-step latch) exist only in the standalone runner, so engine-side gaps in those paths go unwarned.
recommended_fix: Either add engine-side twins of the contention/failed-replay/same-tick-latch checks to PP_Slice1SimTests.cpp, or soften the header to 'mirrors the golden numbers' so the claim matches coverage.

title: Tautological CHECK in spine_check: EcmpHash compared against itself can never fail
detail: The check compares one expression to itself — it can never fail and only inflates the 'always true' check count. The comment says 'pinned values' but none are pinned, unlike every other golden vector in this runner.
recommended_fix: Pin a literal: compute PP::EcmpHash(0,2,0,1) once locally and CHECK it against a hardcoded expected u32, matching the ODN-9 pinned-vector style.

title: flow_summary.spawned computed by two different formulas across the golden writers; they agree only at the canonical 100-tick point
evidence: tests/spine_check.cpp:641: "			static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live" vs PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:137: "			ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score," vs docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md:45: "| `flow_summary.spawned` | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |"
detail: PPProbe counts all demand entries (including never-fired ones), spine-check counts live+delivered. Equal only when every demand entry fired (ticks ≥ 98); a -ticks=50 probe JSON would disagree with both SCHEMA.md's wording and spine-check.
recommended_fix: Make PPProbe count demand entries with Tick <= final tick (fired entries), matching SCHEMA.md's definition and spine-check's formula, so the surfaces cannot drift.
